parse_decode_batch_logs: parse sglang decode batch log lines into a polars DataFrame with typed columns
extract_throughput_metrics: extract generation throughput, token usage, and queue request counts from sglang logs
filter_decode_batch_entries: filter log lines to only decode batch entries with valid throughput data
cast_log_columns_to_types: cast extracted log fields to appropriate polars types like Datetime, Int64, Float64
parse_multiple_ranks_from_logs: parse DP, TP, EP, PP rank information from distributed sglang log entries
